name: Atlas App Beta Redesign / design_handoff_atlas_beta
note: Beta redesign: flat/borderless paper scale (#f9f7f4 → #f1eeea → #fffdfa), Atlas Blue #3461f2, Hanken Grotesk / Geist / Geist Mono, icon set 1a Precision, a sphere on every screen driven by one state bus, a top bar on every screen, hero view transitions, Talk to Atlas (⌥Space). 25 .dc.html references + 9 runtime .js files. The README's rule: implement the features, not just the look. Shipped behind a beta_ui flag per phase; the handoff's 8 phases are tracked on the roadmap site (atlas-roadmap, phase 'Beta redesign').
